items.question: What is Epic Startup?
items.answer: Epic Startup is an enterprise-grade, full-stack monorepo template built with React Router 7, Astro, Tailwind CSS, and Cloudflare edge infrastructure.

items.question: How does the CMS work?
items.answer: Content is managed natively via Emdash CMS, storing data in Cloudflare D1 and media in R2 with sub-millisecond edge delivery.

items.question: Can I deploy on my own Cloudflare account?
items.answer: Yes! With a single command (npx wrangler deploy), your entire marketing site and CMS deploy globally across Cloudflare's edge.

data.title: Welcome to Epic Stack with Emdash CMS

children.text: We are excited to introduce Emdash CMS as our native Astro CMS engine. Running directly on Cloudflare D1 and R2, it gives us sub-millisecond edge response times and instant content editing.

data.title: Scaling Full-Stack Applications at the Edge

children.text: Edge architecture eliminates traditional server bottlenecks by co-locating data and compute as close to the user as possible.
